extra.text: WHAT IS THE CAPITAL OF JAPAN

Leonardo da Vinci.

Water boils at two hundred and twelve degrees Fahrenheit at standard atmospheric pressure.

The sky is blue because water molecules in the atmosphere refract light,
causing the color of the sky to appear blue.

The distance from the Earth to the Moon is approximately three lakh eighty-four thousand four hundred kilometers.

The largest planet in our solar system is Jupiter.

The invention of the telephone was made by Alexander Graham Bell.

Bees make honey.

A week has seven days,
so there are seven hours in a week.

Photo synthesis is the process of converting light energy into chemical energy.
